interface.longDescription:
Prepare for the MRCGP Simulated Consultation Assessment (SCA) with focused coaching for GP trainees. Connect your SCA Prep account to review saved simulated-consultation feedback, understand recent progress, identify recurring weaknesses and find relevant practice cases.

Turn feedback into short, interactive drills covering agenda setting, ideas, concerns and expectations (ICE), psychosocial exploration, shared decision making, explaining uncertainty, safety netting and consultation structure. You can also practise a specific skill or discuss simulated feedback you provide.

SCA Prep retains your saved marks: coaching does not re-mark attempts or predict an exam pass. The account connection is read-only. Full simulations and marking remain on the SCA Prep website. This is an independent educational aid, not patient care or an official RCGP assessment.

SCA Prep is owned and operated by Fetched Wellness Ltd (company number 14586905).

Turn my recent SCA feedback into a targeted practice drill.
